decisions.reason: AURS confirms Akkari as a Rabat quartier and documents the Ocean-Akkari urban-renovation program, but the reviewed first-party pages do not expose a directly reusable neighborhood polygon or a complete machine-defensible boundary description.

decisions.reason: AURS describes Al Boustane as a 270 ha Rabat quartier bounded north by rocade urbaine no. 3, west and south by the green belt, and east by private properties. This is strong spatial context but not a complete directly reusable digital polygon; no synthetic contour is derived from the prose.

sources.title: Al Boustane : un quartier novateur de l'approche environnementale de l'urbanisme
